quantity.name: uniaxial secondary-creep strain and recovered Norton parameters

reference.source: Norton law at constant stress and temperature: epsilon_dot = A sigma^n exp[-Q/(R T)], so epsilon_creep(t)=epsilon_dot t.
reference.confirmed_from: Evaluated independently for A=1e-6, n=3, Q=50000 J/mol, sigma=100 MPa, T=1000 K, t=10 s.

tolerance.metric: relative error in the 100 MPa, 1000 K final creep strain
tolerance.rationale: One percent allows time integration and nonlinear solve error; parameter-regression tolerances are stated separately and are not tuned to any single run.
